intro: A bowl of laksa Penang (asam laksa) is roughly 450 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the thick laksa noodles. The sour fish broth itself is quite light.
diet: Yes, this is one of the most diet-friendly laksas. No santan, low fat, and protein from the fish. Just watch the sweet prawn paste and the noodle portion. Great for a weekend lunch.
tips: Ask for less petis or have it on the side.
Ask for more veg like cucumber and onion.
Add a boiled egg for more protein.

swap.name: Small asam laksa + egg
swap.why: Same taste, fewer noodles and more protein.

faq.q: What's the difference between laksa Penang and laksa kari?
faq.a: Laksa Penang uses a sour fish broth with no santan. Laksa kari uses a thick curry broth with santan.

faq.q: What fish is used in asam laksa?
faq.a: Usually ikan kembung or sardines, boiled and flaked finely into the broth.
It comes from asam keping or tamarind cooked in the broth.
